Original signed BSG 9.7 V32 as a system app, with the verified native cache fix.
Historical Android 16 GSI evidence only; no new device validation during
reorganization. The recommended XML is the owner-provided V32 profile (755 preferences), imported manually. The owner confirms V32 and telephoto OIS work correctly on Android 16 GSI. Any compatible external GCam can also be installed without this system module.
RAW, OIS and flash are maintained separately:
https://github.com/SRE-0/infinix_x6810_raw
